question: Why do climate scientists wait for 30 years of weather before calling a change climate?
answer: Because single years swing more than the trend moves. A country's average temperature can jump by a degree from one year to the next, while warming adds about 0.2°C a decade. The WMO defines climate normals as 30-year averages, long enough for drift to rise above noise. One cold winter is one toss.
move: Do not judge a trend from a single point, however vivid it is.
ask: Which trend in my life am I judging from one good or bad week?
reference: World Meteorological Organization, WMO Guidelines on the Calculation of Climate Normals, WMO-No. 1203, 2017
